q: By law, when must federal elections be held?
zq: 依法，聯邦選舉必須在什麼時候舉行？
o: The first Monday of September every five years
The third Monday in October every four years
zo: 每五年 9 月第一個星期一
每四年 10 月第三個星期一
e: The Prime Minister may also ask the Governor General to call an earlier election.
ze: 總理也可以請總督提前舉行選舉。

q: What is an electoral district also called?
zq: 選區還有什麼別稱？
e: Each riding elects one MP to the House of Commons.
ze: 每個選區選出一位國會議員進入眾議院。

q: How old must a Canadian citizen be to run in a federal election?
zq: 加拿大公民幾歲才能參選聯邦選舉？
e: Citizens 18 or older may run; those who run are called candidates.
ze: 18 歲以上可參選；參選者稱為候選人。

q: Which of the following is NOT a requirement to vote in a federal election?
zq: 下列哪一項不是聯邦選舉的投票資格？
o: Being at least 18 on voting day
e: Property ownership stopped being a requirement long ago; the three requirements are citizenship, age 18, and the voters' list.
ze: 擁有財產早已不是條件；三項資格是公民、18 歲、在選民名冊上。

q: Which neutral agency of Parliament produces the voters' lists from the National Register of Electors?
zq: 哪個國會中立機構根據全國選民登記冊製作選民名冊？
e: Elections Canada mails a voter information card to each elector once an election is called.
ze: 選舉一經宣布，加拿大選舉局會寄選民資訊卡給每位選民。

q: True or false: If you do not receive a voter information card, you cannot vote.
zq: 是非題：如果沒收到選民資訊卡，你就不能投票。
e: You can be added to the voters' list at any time, including on election day.
ze: 你隨時可以被加入選民名冊，包括選舉日當天。

q: What does the secret ballot mean?
zq: 「不記名投票」是什麼意思？
o: You must tell your employer how you voted
No one can watch you vote and no one should look at how you voted
Only the government knows your vote
zo: 你必須告訴雇主投給誰
沒人可以看你投票，也沒人應該看你投給了誰
只有政府知道你的投票
e: No one, including family, employer or union, has the right to insist you tell them.
ze: 沒有人——包括家人、雇主、工會——有權堅持要你說。

q: After an election, who is invited by the Governor General to form the government?
zq: 選舉後，總督邀請誰組成政府？
o: The leader of the party with the most seats in the House of Commons
zo: 眾議院席次最多政黨的領袖
e: That leader becomes the Prime Minister.
ze: 該領袖成為總理。

q: What is a majority government?
zq: 什麼是「多數政府」？
o: When the party in power holds at least half of the seats in the House of Commons
When the party in power wins the Senate
zo: 執政黨在眾議院擁有至少一半席次
e: With less than half the seats it is a minority government.
ze: 席次不到一半就是少數政府。

q: When the House of Commons votes on the budget, this is considered a matter of what?
zq: 眾議院對預算投票時，這被視為什麼？
e: If a majority votes against a major government decision, the government is defeated and an election usually follows.
ze: 多數議員否決重大決定則政府被擊敗，通常接著舉行選舉。

q: The opposition party with the most members of the House of Commons is called what?
zq: 眾議院席次最多的反對黨叫什麼？
o: The Official Opposition or Her Majesty's Loyal Opposition
zo: 官方反對黨（女王陛下的忠誠反對黨）
e: The role of opposition parties is to peacefully oppose or try to improve government proposals.
ze: 反對黨的角色是和平反對或設法改善政府提案。

q: Which three major political parties does the guide name as represented in the House of Commons?
zq: 指南列出眾議院有席次的三大政黨是哪三個？
zo: 保守黨、新民主黨、自由黨
自由黨、綠黨、魁北克集團
e: The Conservative Party, the New Democratic Party and the Liberal Party.
ze: 保守黨、新民主黨和自由黨。

q: How do you mark your ballot?
zq: 你怎麼畫選票？
o: Sign your name next to the candidate
Mark an "X" in the circle next to the candidate of your choice
zo: 在你選擇的候選人旁的圓圈裡畫「X」
勾選所有你喜歡的候選人
e: Then fold the ballot and present it to the poll officials.
ze: 然後摺起選票交給工作人員。

q: What does the poll official do with your ballot after you have marked it?
zq: 你畫好選票後，工作人員做什麼？
o: Reads it and records your vote
Tears off the ballot number and gives it back to you to deposit in the ballot box
zo: 撕下選票編號後交還給你投進投票箱
e: This keeps the vote secret while ensuring each ballot is counted.
ze: 這樣既保密又確保每張選票被計算。

q: If you cannot vote on election day, what can you do?
zq: 如果選舉日不能投票，你可以怎麼做？
o: Vote at the advance polls or by special ballot
Ask a family member to vote for you
zo: 提前投票或用特別選票
e: The dates and location of advance polls are on your voter information card.
ze: 提前投票的日期和地點在選民資訊卡上。

q: The Canadian justice system is founded on which principle in criminal matters?
zq: 加拿大司法系統在刑事案件上建立在什麼原則之上？
o: The presumption of innocence — everyone is innocent until proven guilty
zo: 無罪推定——被證明有罪前人人無辜
e: Everyone is guaranteed due process under the law.
ze: 每個人依法享有正當程序。

q: What is due process?
zq: 什麼是「正當程序」？
o: The right to a quick trial
The principle that the government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law
The process of becoming a citizen
zo: 政府必須尊重一個人依法享有的所有法律權利的原則
e: Canada's legal system rests on the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process.
ze: 加拿大法律制度建立在法治、法律之下的自由、民主原則和正當程序之上。

q: What is Canada's highest court?
zq: 加拿大最高的法院是什麼？
e: The Supreme Court of Canada has nine judges appointed by the Governor General.
ze: 加拿大最高法院有九位總督任命的法官。

q: Which court deals with matters concerning the federal government?
zq: 哪個法院處理與聯邦政府有關的事務？
e: Provinces also have appeal courts, trial courts, family, traffic and small claims courts.
ze: 各省還有上訴法院、審判法院、家事、交通和小額索賠法院。

q: In Canada, the law applies to whom?
zq: 在加拿大，法律適用於誰？
o: Everyone, including judges, politicians and the police
zo: 每一個人，包括法官、政治人物和警察
e: No person or group is above the law.
ze: 沒有人或團體凌駕於法律之上。

q: Which provinces have their own provincial police forces?
zq: 哪些省有自己的省警察？
zo: 新斯科細亞與新布藍瑞克
e: The RCMP serves as the provincial police everywhere except Ontario and Quebec.
ze: 皇家騎警在安大略和魁北克以外的省和地區擔任省警察。

q: True or false: You can question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to.
zq: 是非題：如果你覺得有必要，可以質疑警察的服務或行為。
e: Almost all police forces have a process for bringing concerns and seeking action.
ze: 幾乎所有警察機關都有反映疑慮並要求處理的程序。

q: If you cannot pay for a lawyer, what is available in most communities?
zq: 如果付不起律師費，大多數社區有什麼？
o: Legal aid services free of charge or at low cost
zo: 免費或低收費的法律援助服務
e: Lawyers can help with legal problems and act for you in court.
ze: 律師可以幫你處理法律問題並在法庭代表你。

q: When was the current Canadian flag raised for the first time?
zq: 現在的加拿大國旗在哪一年第一次升起？
e: Red and white have been the national colours since 1921; the flag dates from 1965.
ze: 紅白自 1921 年起是國家代表色；國旗 1965 年誕生。

q: Which flag served as the Canadian flag for about 100 years before 1965?
zq: 1965 年以前約一百年間，哪面旗幟作為加拿大國旗？
e: The Union Jack is the official Royal Flag; the Red Ensign was the Canadian flag for about 100 years.
ze: 英國國旗是正式的王室旗幟；紅船旗約一百年間作為加拿大國旗。

q: What is Canada's best-known symbol?
zq: 加拿大最著名的象徵是什麼？
e: Maple leaves have appeared on Canadian uniforms since the 1850s.
ze: 楓葉自 1850 年代起出現在加拿大軍服上。

q: What does Canada's national motto "A mari usque ad mare" mean?
zq: 加拿大國家格言「A mari usque ad mare」是什麼意思？
e: The coat of arms and motto were adopted after the First World War.
ze: 國徽和格言在第一次世界大戰後採用。

q: The Peace Tower on Parliament Hill was completed in 1927 in memory of what?
zq: 國會山莊的和平塔 1927 年完工，是為了紀念什麼？
e: The Memorial Chamber contains the Books of Remembrance.
ze: 塔內的紀念廳存放《紀念名冊》。

q: What is Canada's national winter sport?
zq: 加拿大的國家冬季運動是什麼？
e: Hockey is the most popular spectator sport; the NHL plays for the Stanley Cup, donated in 1892 by Lord Stanley.
ze: 曲棍球是最受歡迎的觀賞運動；NHL 爭奪 1892 年史丹利勳爵捐贈的史丹利盃。

q: What is Canada's official summer sport?
zq: 加拿大官方的夏季運動是什麼？
e: Lacrosse is an ancient sport first played by Aboriginals.
ze: 袋棍球是原住民最早玩的古老運動。

q: On which coin can the beaver be seen?
zq: 海狸出現在哪一種硬幣上？
e: The beaver was a symbol of the Hudson's Bay Company and appears on the five-cent coin.
ze: 海狸曾是哈德遜灣公司的象徵，出現在五分硬幣上。

q: When was O Canada proclaimed the national anthem?
zq: 《噢！加拿大》在哪一年被宣布為國歌？
e: It was first sung in Québec City in 1880 and proclaimed the anthem in 1980.
ze: 1880 年首次在魁北克市演唱，1980 年宣布為國歌。

q: What is the Royal Anthem of Canada?
zq: 加拿大的皇家國歌是什麼？
e: It can be played or sung on any occasion when Canadians wish to honour the Sovereign.
ze: 在加拿大人想向君主致敬的任何場合都可以演奏或演唱。

q: In what year did Canada start its own honours system with the Order of Canada?
zq: 加拿大在哪一年以「加拿大勳章」開始自己的榮譽制度？
e: 1967, the centennial of Confederation.
ze: 1967 年，聯邦成立一百週年。

q: What is the highest honour available to Canadians?
zq: 加拿大人能獲得的最高榮譽是什麼？
e: The V.C. has been awarded to 96 Canadians since 1854.
ze: 自 1854 年起已有 96 位加拿大人獲頒。

q: When is Victoria Day?
zq: 維多利亞日是什麼時候？
zo: 5 月 25 日之前的星期一
e: Victoria Day marks the Sovereign's birthday.
ze: 維多利亞日是君主誕辰。

q: When is Thanksgiving Day in Canada?
zq: 加拿大的感恩節是什麼時候？
e: Labour Day is the first Monday of September; Boxing Day is December 26.
ze: 勞動節是 9 月第一個星期一；節禮日是 12 月 26 日。

q: What are the three main objectives of the Official Languages Act of 1969?
zq: 1969 年《官方語言法》的三大目標是什麼？
o: Make everyone bilingual, close English schools, promote French abroad
Establish equality of French and English in federal institutions, maintain official language minority communities, and promote equality of French and English in society
Make French the only official language, fund Quebec, end immigration
Teach French in all provinces, ban other languages, promote English
zo: 讓人人雙語、關閉英語學校、對外推廣法語
在聯邦機構建立英法平等、維持官方語言少數社群、在社會中促進英法平等
讓法語成為唯一官方語言、資助魁北克、停止移民
在各省教法語、禁止其他語言、推廣英語
e: English and French are important symbols of identity.
ze: 英語和法語是重要的身分象徵。
